# Bank b2 goldens provenance

Captured 2026-08-23 from real MCPX APU GP silicon (original Xbox console,
xbtest oracle, one fresh boot per case, sequential replay to
each case's patched end PC). Runner: xbtest `client/run_corpus_hw.py` with
the stack-slot-zeroing preamble. Corpus generated by `corpus.py` bank "b2"
(moves/L-moves/limiting, LUA data-register destinations, AGU modulo and
bit-reverse edges, displacement moves, MOVEC matrix, stack, control flow,
condition-code sweep, loop boundary cases). 71/71 cases reached their end
PC and match the JIT.

The BRKcc cases use the legal spelling (no arithmetic immediately before
the brk, per manual restriction A.3.4, and placed outside the LA-2..LA
zone); spelled that way, silicon restores the loop state exactly per the
manual. Restriction-violating spellings behave differently or wedge the
core - see docs/ARCHITECTURE-NOTES.md "Restriction-violation behaviors"
for the probe matrix. Also pinned by this bank: REP #0 executes its target
zero times, and DO #0 annuls.
